notes.title: Beyond Art
notes.content:
In "Layers of Fear," the profound impact of art on individuals serves as a core element of the narrative. Here are some fascinating details that we hope will inspire you to delve deeper into this intriguing theme.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/64b6f0db26a4461b136c2d7eada875d69bf5ef6f.jpg[/img]

Take the "Lady with an Ermine", by Leonardo da Vinci, currently the most valuable painting in any museum located in Poland. You can admire it at the Princes Czartoryski Museum in Krakow. This renowned portrait inspired us to create the eerie image of the Rat Queen herself. Legends of the Rat Queen haunt the artistic community: some dismiss her as an urban myth, while others swear by her existence. What a delightful mosaic of secrets! 

Within the painter's mansion, you'll also discover a treasure trove of astounding artworks. Among them is "Portrait of a Man in a Turban" by Jan van Eyck - a piece by an artist confident in his prowess. Have you ever wondered why you encounter this painting here? Jan van Eyck is credited with pioneering portraits that gaze directly at the viewer... Can you feel that penetrating stare? 

We encourage you to continue your exploration. In the mansion, you'll encounter paintings by Rembrandt, the horrifying "Saturn Devouring His Son" by Francisco Goya, a portrait of Antonietta Gonzalez suffering from hypertrichosis painted by Lavinia Fontana, and artworks by John Frederick Herring. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/2fa41f770774dd4121bc1232c6f6f6a75af76468.jpg[/img]

Finally, one last curiosity. In the mansion, you’ll find a particularly unique portrait of one of our most devoted fans and a staunch supporter of the "Layers of Fear" series - a mystical lady named Zerachiel Amora. This portrait is a token of our gratitude for her support of our charity work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/387ef00b27e14a3ae55c976a232350b0f0d31348.png[/img]

notes.title: Nominate Layers of Fear at the Steam Awards 2023!
notes.content:
Along with enjoying massive discounts during Steam’s annual Autumn Sale, you can also nominate your favorite games in 11 different categories for a chance to win at the upcoming Steam Awards.
As the crowning work of our most beloved series, we’ve put Layers of Fear up for contention for several categories, which we feel best encapsulate the strengths of our game. Chief among those is:

[b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game [/b]- A strong emphasis on narrative has always been one of Bloober Team’s core values. With Layers of Fear (2023) we’ve sought to create a fitting conclusion to our tale of artistic impulse gone wrong, and in the process created the definitive version of our breakthrough title.

[previewyoutube=JJMeiW0Gz_Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pride ourselves on making games that excel in both the visual and audio department, so we suggest putting up our game for consideration in the following categories as well:

[b]Outstanding Visual Style[/b] - As part of our dedication towards harnessing the latest technology to achieve a truly immersive experience, we’ve rebuilt Layers of Fear (2023) from the ground up using Unreal Engine 5, which has allowed us to achieve unparalleled graphical fidelity, while preserving the unique look and feel of this universe.

[previewyoutube=iMkN8whZQmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Best Soundtrack - The work of Arkadiusz Reikowski and his team has been instrumental in creating the mood and atmosphere of Layers of Fear (2023), using dissonance and unsettling melodies to enhance the game’s horror elements, and deserves to be recognized for its outstanding contribution to the game’s overall experience.

[previewyoutube=mhTDMyP3AKo;full][/previewyoutube]

If you feel the same way about Layers of Fear (2023), we invite you to nominate our game at the upcoming Steam Awards using this link:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations]The Steam Awards (steampowered.com)[/url]

Voting is open until the 28th of November at 10 AM PST. 
We appreciate your support and are grateful to have such a passionate community of fans!

notes.title: Layers of Fear – Official Song [You Are My Sunshine – Natalia Szroeder]
notes.content:
"You Are My Sunshine" is a remarkable collaboration between Bloober Team and Polish artist Natalia Szroeder, created to celebrate the horror game developer’s 15th anniversary. This melancholic tune, accompanied by its enigmatic music video, offers a fresh interpretation of a classic song, once performed by the legendary Johnny Cash. The project pays homage to the die-hard fans of the Layers of Fear universe, a series that left an indelible mark on narrative-driven horror games. Much like the game itself, the music video takes the audience on an immersive journey into the shadowy realm of artistic expression, showcasing the beautiful yet challenging relationship between humanity and art.

notes.title: New Layers of Fear, Also for the Series' Old Fans
notes.content:
The game holds a few surprises even for seasoned players familiar with the Layers of Fear series.

[b]Fend off Threats With Light albo Repel the Evil With Light[/b]
 
First of all, the Lantern mechanic - lighting up rooms and warding off sinister powers - is already well known to you and discussed in earlier news, providing a fresh experience to the original games

[b]Wait, Was That Here Before?[/b] 
 
However, that's not all, as the changes go deeper. The layout of certain rooms has been altered to increase tension and better emphasize the story of the characters. Additionally, the set of riddles has been updated with new ones, and some of the old ones have been modified to keep things fresh and engaging.

[b]More Immersion
[/b] 
The way exploration is done in the game has been changed. Some of the notes and letters that were present before now have accompanying soundtracks. Additionally, there are now fewer possible hiding spots to investigate, and furniture that may contain items is more distinguishable from furniture that is unlikely to hold anything valuable.

[b]Whether you're a long-time fan of the series or just delving in, get ready to be absorbed into a world of fear and mystery.[/b]

notes.title: A Horror-Fueled Journey Into the Depths of Art and Madness
notes.content:
In [b]Layers of Fear[/b], you are taken on a chilling ride through madness and horror, all while paying tribute to the world of art. Throughout the story, you’ll find inside the game various references to painting and cinematography.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/a5450ea719c07aa71e70366a3bc367c7f7f7c7d3.png[/img]
[h2]HAUNTING PAINTINGS OF THE LAYERS OF FEAR[/h2]

The mansion in the first [b]Layers of Fear[/b] is adorned with classical paintings by great artists such as Rembrandt and John Frederick Herring. However, the paintings also carry a dark twist, including sinister inspirations and references. 

The eerie collection also features famous works like [b]"Portrait of a Man" by Jan van Eyck[/b], famously trailing the viewer's eyes. Additionally, [b]"Mars" by Goya[/b] and [b]"Portrait of Antonietta Gonzalez" by Lavinia Fontana[/b] add a haunting element to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/d00c76d1a820054338f0d1e9b22b3f9cad7e490c.png[/img]
[h2]MENACING INSPIRATIONS FROM CINEMATOGRAPHY[/h2]

The second part of [b]Layers of Fear[/b] continues the motive of arts. Mysterious mannequins that you encounter throughout the game recreate scenes from famous cinematic classics such as [b]"Metropolis" and "Journey to the Moon"[/b]. These figures spin tales straight out of the terrifying [b]"Seven"[/b].

[h2]EERIE EASTER EGGS[/h2]

But that's not all! The game is also littered with other ghoulishly modified works of art, such as [b]Leonardo da Vinci’s "Lady with an Ermine"[/b], movie posters, and even a stylized portrait of one of the biggest fans of the [b]Layers of Fear[/b] series. 


In short, [b]Layers of Fear[/b] is a one-of-a-kind journey that takes you into the abyss of spookily unusual art history.

notes.title: New Protagonist Steps up in the Upcoming Layers of Fear
notes.content:
In the upcoming last installment of the Layers series, a fresh character will take center stage — the Writer. What details about the character can we disclose to you at this moment? Set in the 1950s and 1960s America, the story follows a determined African-American woman's quest to garner worldwide recognition through her literary prowess.

One day, the Writer relocates to a far-flung lighthouse. Intent on crafting her lifetime masterpiece, she encounters more than she bargained for in this isolated surrounding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/08c8e3651e4864b43226c96ebf9a12ba61723ea7.jpg[/img]

The looming abandoned lighthouse — a place of unknown origin, erected by an equally mysterious entity. Its dark atmosphere is palpable, with hints of a ghostly entity lurking within its walls. The Rat Queen's eerie apparition and haunting painting only add to the enigma.

[previewyoutube=xBsA2T_7inI;full][/previewyoutube]

Despite the eerie environment, our heroine is determined to complete her book, and nothing will stand in her way. But we see the cost of her ambition, as her relationship with her beloved son grows increasingly strained, and ominous signs suggest that something terrible has befallen their once-strong bond. 

[previewyoutube=RLQxLI7WBuM;full][/previewyoutube]

With every moment spent in the lighthouse, darkness creeps closer to our Writer. Her mission to uncover its secrets will unravel hidden truths about her identity and unearth the true nature of a cryptic being that lurks within its haunted corridors.

See for yourself how the Writer’s fate resolves. Find out the true identity of the mysterious figure pulling the strings behind all three artists in June. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: Lantern: The New Game Mechanic in Layers of Fear
notes.content:
Significant changes have been made to the Layers of Fear game, including the addition of a lantern, which we believe will quickly become appreciated for its usefulness and its impact on shaping the vibe of the spooky Victorian mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/0c5187ba9bba90e5b912af061c71c8a99e0f2ca9.jpg[/img]

The lantern serves as an essential tool for players to fend off dangerous threats, decipher puzzles, and navigate dimly lit corridors in search of details hidden in the old house. Not limited to its utilitarian nature, the lantern is also a mood-enhancing device that helps to create a tense atmosphere as you explore the dark nooks and crannies filled with the goo-like substance of the old mansion.

The tool's light can temporarily fend off the malevolent entity lurking in the shadows as you make your way through the game. However, you must use it wisely as it consumes resources and takes time to recharge. During your game, the lantern serves three fundamental functions which we'll now take a look at.

[previewyoutube=bnm4avgFUOM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]DETER THE EVIL
[/b]
Deep in the haunted halls of the first Layers of Fear, a sinister presence lurks in the shadows. Players soon discover that the malevolent entity is vulnerable to intense light, and in their desperation for protection, they seek to utilize this weakness to their advantage. Using the lantern to create intense light, players can keep themselves out of harm's way.

[b]RIDDLE-SOLVING [/b]

Some of the puzzles in the eerie walls of the old mansion have changed. The lantern has now become a key tool in unlocking the secrets of the Victorian mansion.

[b]LIGHT UP THE DARKNESS[/b] 
 
The eerie and quiet corridors of the old mansion can sometimes make you feel paralyzed. In these situations, illumination can be used simply for reassurance and to combat the feeling of dread.

[previewyoutube=WPnmU9b5e0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

During GDC testing, players expressed great delight in using the lantern to re-discover every inch of the familiar locations from the original game. This novelty, we believe, has made the game more immersive and realistic, which is what it's all about, after all.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: A straightforward explanation of what is Layers of Fear
notes.content:
Layers of Fear, our flagship franchise, will receive a new installment and it is expected to be the crowning work of the series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/7f5ba1257926ee64f62f35db18789fcffb8fffa1.png[/img]

Our upcoming June premiere cannot be easily categorized as a remake or remaster. Instead, it can be best described as a "reimagination". The team's goal was to pay tribute to the two classic games while also expanding the lore with a fresh story that sheds new light on the events of the first and second Layers. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1946700/extras/02c.gif?t=1681473551[/img]

Layers of Fear combines these elements: 
[list]
[*] A full-fledged, revitalized Layers of Fear from 2016
[*] A full-fledged, revitalized Layers of Fear 2 from 2019
[*] The original DLC “Inheritance”
[*] A new protagonist: the Writer
[*] A new story: the Lighthouse
[*] Bonus new content: the “Final Note” chapter
[*] Lantern, a new item that changes the game mechanic
[*] ...and that's not all (we have our secrets) ;)
[/list]
[b]An engrossing story of the Writer set in a lonesome lighthouse will tie the intricate stories of all Layers chapters together. Stay tuned for our next news, as we cover the mechanics of the lantern. 
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946700/Layers_of_Fear/

notes.title: There is something special about the new lighting in the game!
notes.content:
From now on, we are just counting down the days until Layers of Fear launches in June. Recently, our team had the opportunity to attend the San Francisco Game Developers Conference where we publicly showcased a demo of the game for the very first time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42506694/df4684704df8bb9439bb31cd2caae9503e677874.jpg[/img]

Our first opportunity to gauge player reception of the new Layers of Fear was fruitful. We were able to determine what elements players gravitated towards, what evoked emotion, and ultimately, their overall impressions.


Despite the bustling convention being far from ideal for immersing oneself in a haunted mansion, game testers were still deeply moved by our latest Layers of Fear installment. Attendees at our booth were completely engrossed in the game, exploring every nook and cranny of the intricately detailed mansion, scrutinizing every item and note they found, and admiring the overall design of the game.


Reviewers noted that the game's new lighting was a standout feature, with its photorealism and ability to evoke a sense of horror being a huge asset. Additionally, players were drawn to the new lantern feature that not only changed the gameplay but also added to the game's eerie atmosphere.


Overall, we left the convention feeling satisfied with our game's reception. [b]Would you like to try it out for yourself before release?[/b]

notes.title: Layers of Fear has won big at the NYX Game Awards
notes.content:
Layers of Fear has won big at the NYX Game Awards, taking home three awards for our marketing efforts: Teaser, Trailer, and Key Art. In addition, the Bloober Team was honored with the title of Best Developer.

Our Teaser and Gamescom trailers for Layers of Fear received the Grand Winner awards in the Game Video - Teaser category. Plus, our Key Art was also recognized with the Gold Winner award in the Game Design category.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and assets about the game, as we prepare for the launch in June 2023. Keep an eye on us and be sure to add Layers of Fear to your wishlist!

notes.title: Official 11-Minute Gameplay Walkthrough
notes.content:
Get an exclusive first-look at the gameplay of Layers of Fear, the series’ crowning work, in this 11-minute walkthrough. 

Follow the Painter from the original Layers of Fear, and join the Writer — a recently unveiled character — for a closer look at the latest installment in the Layers franchise.

As The Writer, enter the lone and ghastly Lighthouse — a newly-introduced location — and uncover an untold story that links all of the Layers’ characters and events together. Unravel secrets, solve puzzles, and face the threats of the old Mansion that can only be solved with a lantern — a new and essential tool to confront the nightmares in the game!

Feast your eyes on the vibrant visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, featuring technologies like Lumen, Ray Tracing, HDR, volumetric lighting and Niagara–creating graphics as lifelike as possible. 

The canvas awaits its final brushstrokes. 
The stage calls for its lead actor. 
The novel needs its final chapter. 
It’s time to face your fears. 
One. Last. Time.

Layers of Fear coming out June 2023

notes.content:
Enter a lone and ghastly lighthouse and discover a never-told-before tale that ties the whole series together.

Layers of Fear (2023) is the crowning work of the Layers series that features 2016's Layers of Fear, along with its expansion "Inheritance" and the later sequel Layers of Fear 2. notes.title: “The Final Note” - a brand-new story chapter
notes.content:
“The Final Note” - a brand-new story chapter, designed exclusively for the psychedelic horror chronicle of Layers of Fears and featuring the Painter’s Wife as the playable protagonist!

[previewyoutube=PEhgXjPMyyM;full][/previewyoutube]

Created with the cutting-edge Unreal Engine 5 technology, the game will support Ray Tracing, HDR effect, 4K resolution, and make use of the Lumen system to offer the most immersive and visceral horror experience.

Layers of Fears will be the complete, definitive and at the same time unpredictable way to discover the stories of artists enslaved by their obsessions. Prepare for an exquisite horror experience thanks to the expanded plot lines that will cast a new light on the overarching narrative.
